description: The constraint level FCAS cost / price details for constraint FCAS processor runs. This enhanced output table format is established for the constraint FCAS processor release required for the Frequency Performance Payments (FPP) release. This enhanced output is hierarchical in nature, with the parent *_FCAS_REQ_RUN table holding the details about the triggering case run and time, and the child *_FCAS_REQ_CONSTRAINT table holding the constraint level details of FCAS costs / prices.
